title: PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI
summary: Standard vehicle drive (engine, gears, clutch and an optional automatic gear box) on the vehicle prim or on a separate prim that physxVehicle:drive targets. Outside the drive parse the runtime only checks whether the vehicle prim itself lists it, to take the vehicle prim as the drive when physxVehicle:drive has no target.

interactions.rule: Listing both PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI and PhysxVehicleDriveBasicAPI on a vehicle prim without a physxVehicle:drive target logs an error and the vehicle is not created.
A tank controller requires a standard drive.

notes: The runtime resolves physxVehicleDriveStandard:engine, gears, autoGearBox and clutch (the relationship target, or the drive prim itself when it lists the matching component API) and wires the parsed components into the drive; their components' columns are not described yet.
